item.title: Flu cases spike in Greene County
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Flu cases in the Ozarks have continued to rise as the holiday season approaches. While the Missouri Department of Health & Senior Services weekly report shows overall flu activity in Missouri has been low, there is a rise within Greene County, with currently 262 cases reported, including 59 new infections last week. item.title: Firefighters contain early morning Ozark house fire
item.description: Local firefighters responded to a house fire in Ozark early Monday morning, which was caused by a fireplace and quickly contained, resulting in no injuries and minimal damage to the home.

item.title: City Utilities calls for Boil Water Advisory for certain areas in Springfield
item.description: City Utilities crews are working to repair a water main break near 1613 East Woodgate Street, which is affecting water pressure in the surrounding areas, and a boil advisory may be issued depending on the progress of the repairs.

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Dec. 8-12
item.description: Routine inspections of food establishments in Springfield revealed a total of 15 priority violations and 10 nonpriority violations, ranging from improper sanitizer concentrations to food items not being properly labeled or refrigerated.
